propositions: Destructive repair must acquire durable pause ownership via refs/reconciler/gate before mutation, eliminating GitHub CLI workflow-disable/enable dependency.
Repair sequence is fail-closed: missing git email, pre-existing foreign pause, pause CAS failure, held/corrupt reconciler lock, or lock uncertainty all abort before mutation.
Pause cleanup must read the pause document and OID as one atomic snapshot, then CAS-delete only if the stored reason matches the invocation token.
Missing, replaced, or changed pause after ownership acquisition must abort cleanup without retry or recreation, leaving the bridge paused for operator recovery.
Both fsck --repair and doctor --repair use the same shared repair-owned pause contract without changing public vocabulary or non-repair behavior.
